title: A lattice-theoretic framework for hesitant fuzzy convexity beyond scalar observables
summary: In fuzzy-set theory, the notion of convexity has often been formulated through scalar reductions, typically via scores and aggregation functions. Although useful, such reductions may obscure relevant order-theoretic information in the codomain, especially in complex set-valued settings. This article develops a lattice-theoretic framework for convexity on lattice-valued mappings over point-convex segment-generated abstract convexity spaces.
